sentences.text: If you dig a gap and lay a plank across, you have a bridge.
But a car rolls onto the plank and it snaps.
So you add steel girders under the plank.
But the girders span a long gap, so you add a pier to hold up the middle.
As the car crosses, its weight squeezes the top of the beam and stretches the bottom.
But now a flood fills the river, and the current scours the foot of the pier until it cracks.
So you wrap the pier in concrete and pile rocks round its foot.
And a bridge is not locked rigid.
In summer, a 100 metre steel deck grows about 6 centimetres, so it slides.
Add rails, a centre line, a lamp and young trees.
Congratulations, you have built a bridge.
